selection.rule: The same 30 gold artworks as the disambiguation round, asked the six group-a.probes.v1.1 probes that derive ground_type, one contiguous pass per probe in bundled-p's order. Two pre-registered uses (PREMISE_NEXT.md §12): a probe-native gold with no construct-match caveat, and the model-free reliability test — the reviewer's probe-derived tags against the reviewer's own direct six-way answers on the same images.

questions.question: bg_visible - Can you make out a background at all — anything behind the main subject and the text?
questions.instruction: Answer this one question only. Do not try to make your answers across questions tell one story. If you cannot tell, answer unsure — it is a real answer.
questions.preamble: The background means everything behind the main subject and the text, taken AS A WHOLE — even if it has several different parts.
questions.framing: Unsure is a real answer — some questions won't fit some artworks, and that is measured, not penalized.

answers.label: yes
answers.gloss: there is a background you can see

answers.label: no
answers.gloss: you cannot make out any background
